tests.name: Unknown URL shows a not-found page (not a crash)
Workflow 1: Seller opens the Create Listing page and uploads a phone flat-lay photo of a garment.
tests.sourceRef: Seller opens the Create Listing page and uploads a phone flat-lay photo of a garment.

tests.name: Workflow 2: Browser-side readiness checks run on the image (garment bounding box / framing, background separation, flatness / wrinkle proxy via edge density, occlusion and shadow proxies) and return a pass/fail per check.
tests.sourceRef: Browser-side readiness checks run on the image (garment bounding box / framing, background separation, flatness / wrinkle proxy via edge density, occlusion and shadow proxies) and return a pass/fail per check.

tests.name: Workflow 3: If any check fails, the seller sees up to three specific, ordered retake instructions (e.g. 'lay the garment flat on a plain single-colour surface', 'move the garment fully inside the frame', 'remove the hanger/hand from the shot') and can retake without any API call being made.
tests.sourceRef: If any check fails, the seller sees up to three specific, ordered retake instructions (e.g. 'lay the garment flat on a plain single-colour surface', 'move the garment fully inside the frame', 'remove the hanger/hand from the shot') and can retake without any API call being made.

tests.name: Workflow 4: When checks pass, the server normalises the accepted image (auto-orient, crop to garment bounding box with padding, conservative background suppression, resize/encode to the documented VTO input constraints) and stores it with a computed readiness grade (A/B/C) and a per-check breakdown.
tests.sourceRef: When checks pass, the server normalises the accepted image (auto-orient, crop to garment bounding box with padding, conservative background suppression, resize/encode to the documented VTO input constraints) and stores it with a computed readiness grade (A/B/C) and a per-check breakdown.

tests.name: Workflow 5: Listing publishes with a visible 'try-on ready' badge showing the grade and the reason the grade is not higher.
tests.sourceRef: Listing publishes with a visible 'try-on ready' badge showing the grade and the reason the grade is not higher.

tests.name: Workflow 6: Buyer opens the listing, taps Try it on, reads and accepts a plain-language consent screen covering what is uploaded, where it is sent and when it is deleted.
tests.sourceRef: Buyer opens the listing, taps Try it on, reads and accepts a plain-language consent screen covering what is uploaded, where it is sent and when it is deleted.

tests.name: Workflow 7: Buyer uploads or captures one selfie; the server validates it, strips metadata, and checks the render cache and the API unit budget.
tests.sourceRef: Buyer uploads or captures one selfie; the server validates it, strips metadata, and checks the render cache and the API unit budget.

tests.name: Workflow 8: Server calls the YouCam Apparel Virtual Try-On API server-to-server (upload → create task → bounded polling with timeout and retry) using the normalised garment image and the buyer photo, with honest progress states in the UI.
tests.sourceRef: Server calls the YouCam Apparel Virtual Try-On API server-to-server (upload → create task → bounded polling with timeout and retry) using the normalised garment image and the buyer photo, with honest progress states in the UI.

tests.name: Workflow 9: Render returns and is displayed with the readiness badge inherited from the garment, a persistent preview-only label, and an explicit statement that no fit, size or condition claim is being made; if a silent-failure signal is detected the render is labelled as unreliable rather than shown as a clean success.
tests.sourceRef: Render returns and is displayed with the readiness badge inherited from the garment, a persistent preview-only label, and an explicit statement that no fit, size or condition claim is being made; if a silent-failure signal is detected the render is labelled as unreliable rather than shown as a clean success.

tests.name: Workflow 10: Buyer saves the render to a watchlist; the listing's try-on counter increments and the seller sees try-on count plus readiness grade history on their listing dashboard, with rates suppressed at small sample sizes.
tests.sourceRef: Buyer saves the render to a watchlist; the listing's try-on counter increments and the seller sees try-on count plus readiness grade history on their listing dashboard, with rates suppressed at small sample sizes.
